description: Check a Base token (0x address) or URL for scam and rug risk before buying, or a wallet against the sanctions, USDC-blacklist and known-scam-deployer lists. Returns action OK | CAUTION | AVOID | VERIFY_MORE with the facts behind it and a ready-to-show summary. null means unknown, never safe. Free: 3 a day per IP (counted across the HTTP routes and MCP), then $0.008 per call via x402.

amount_usd.description: Your trade size in USD: adds a sell quote at that size (fields.sell_at_size) and the price impact

compact.description: No summary text, no disclaimer, no null fields

quick.description: Faster check (about 5 s) with fewer facts; skipped facts are null

target.description: Base 0x token address, wallet address or URL
